steps.title: Unit 2 Test
steps.html:
Всё из трёх уроков этого юнита.

  • Урок 4: You're not from here, are you?
  • Урок 5: The family group chat
  • Урок 6: How are you? — the honest answer

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Выберите правильный ответ.
steps.html:
Leila

Hello! I'm Leila.

I'm from Turkey. I'm Turkish.

My email is leila@mail.com.

My friends are from Brazil. They aren't Turkish.

steps.title: Выберите правильное слово.
steps.prompt: Charlie and Anna. ___ son is Fergus.

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.
steps.html:
Kai

Hi! I'm Kai.

This is my family. My father's name is Timur.

My mother is a teacher. Her name is Aygul.

I have one sister. Her son is my nephew — he is two.

steps.title: Найдите ошибку.
steps.why: Перед человеком — their, а не they.

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Выберите правильный ответ.
steps.html:
Ray

Hi! I'm Ray. It's Monday morning.

I'm tired and I'm cold.

My coffee is hot. Now I'm OK!

My sister is happy today — she isn't busy.
